scope: Post-hoc extension motivated by already observed original E2 results. Existing original2175responses remain known; this is not a retroactive confirmatory preregistration. Analysis definitions are fixed before the additional125unfiltered responses.
sample_unit: Same25source-supported questions, one per distinct article; retain every selected question and all outcomes.

benign_primary_exploratory_contrasts.interpretation: Baseline-adjusted relative change in frozen answer-string utility under the controlled transformation. Conditional exploratory pipeline comparison; not semantic correctness, general causal identification or population-wide defense efficacy.

counterfactual_dose.difference_in_differences: Each of3filtered changes minus the corresponding unfiltered change
counterfactual_dose.status: Exploratory, no additional confirmatory hypothesis tests

support_definitions: Use gold_retained and legitimate_support_retained directly from frozen selected requests. These declared document identities do not exhaust all useful evidence. Do not infer support from answer text.

uncertainty.method: Paired article bootstrap, preserving all policies/conditions for each sampled article
uncertainty.interval: 2.5th and97.5th percentiles of paired mean differences
uncertainty.p_values: None: no new confirmatory p-values or multiple-testing success claims
uncertainty.degenerate_intervals: Report observed degeneracy; not equivalence proof

joint_outcomes.T: Frozen target_mention boolean, including quoted/negated occurrences
joint_outcomes.interpretation: Joint string-proxy states; U1_T0 is not a certified secure answer. Do not relabel target mention as semantic adoption.

scorer: Import the unchanged revised_experiment/evaluate_new.py score_row and aliases functions; canonical incorrect only, no post-result alias addition.
